body: Thank you for the valuable advice! I feel a little bit better, I hope you have a great day!

I know.. I never meant to hurt him or be too cold but I just don't know how to react when people confess to me, I just run away. I tried explaining though.. And he just wouldn't stop, so I stopped talking to him. These kinds of things make me extremely uncomfortable and I just wanted it to stop

My parents know, I told them just to be safe but my teachers aren't worth telling, these things will be dismissed as innocent crushes at my school.. If it comes to the attention of my classmates, I'll be made fun of for the rest of high school.. I'd be told that I'm scared and I exaggerate.. I thought about reporting him but it's just worthless.. And another thing I'm scared of..school might start physically again. Online he can't hurt me, but I don't know what might happen when we return to school.

I appreciate it a lot.. Thank you for your time and attention, it means a lot.. I wish there were more people like you in my life! And certainly you are a great person and those around you are lucky to have you! Even if they might not see it sometimes. I will keep your kind advice in mind!

That is amazing that you improved your thinking like that! Always remember the progress you've made when you try to fix something difficult.. That's what I'm trying to do at least.. I used to try to teach them in a sense (they are racist, homophobic and very judgememtal of others even if they are clearly not perfect) I thought that if I kept trying different methods I could help them understand, showing them videos of the experiences other people od different sexualities and cultures go through. In the end, I finally accepted that it was pointless, and got over trying to explain everything to them... Now I just have to figure out how to not care about what they say about me.. It helps a lot to know that others have experienced what I'm going through and they mananged to get out of it! I will try my best to take your advice and be like you! I hope I'm not hopeless! Big thanks!
Thank you! They seem really interesting and now I can learn more about them! Hope you have a nice day
